descriptor: A science lab where you guess what will happen, then test it. Ano helps you find out why.

belief.title: Heavy and light land together
belief.detail: Same size, same drop: they hit the floor at the same moment
An LED only lets current through one way
In a sealed bag, the gas can't get out

lowerBand.heading: Find out where your guess went wrong.
lowerBand.body: Guess what will happen, then press Run. If you're wrong, Ano helps you find out why.

chip.title: How it works
chip.subtitle: Guess, run it, see what happens

lowerBand.explore: Explore {count} experiments in chemistry and robotics

hero.setup: Two balls, the same size. The steel one is about three times heavier than the glass one. Make your guess, then drop them.
hero.wrong: Whoa, they landed together! That surprises lots of people. When air barely slows things down, weight doesn't change how fast they fall.
hero.correctLine: Nailed it! Weight doesn't change how fast things fall. The air barely slows these balls down.

before.title: Does the heavier ball land first?

heavy.title: Heavier didn't mean faster
heavy.detail: They landed together, so weight didn't change the fall

light.title: Lighter didn't mean faster
light.detail: They landed together, so weight didn't change the fall

same.title: Heavy and light land together
same.detail: Same size, same drop, same moment

steps.title: Guess
steps.body: Every experiment starts with your guess. You pick an answer before you press Run. Then the lab shows what really happens.

steps.title: Find the idea
steps.body: If your guess is wrong, Ano tries some common wrong ideas on your build. The one that gives your answer is probably the idea behind your guess.

steps.title: Break it
steps.body: Ano picks one small change where that idea is most wrong. You run it and watch the idea break.

steps.title: Fix it
steps.body: Fix your build and run it again. Keep the idea that matches what really happens.

labs.title: Two labs, one rule
labs.body: You always guess first. Then the lab shows you what really happens.

meetAno.title: Meet Ano
meetAno.body: Your lab partner. When an experiment surprises you, Ano helps you find out why, one small step at a time.

lines.happy: Hi, I'm Ano! You guess first, then we test it. Ready?
lines.curious: Ooh, nice. So, what do you think will happen?
lines.thinking: Hmm. Which part do you think matters most here?
lines.surprised: Whoa, did you see that? Let's work out why.
lines.celebrating: Nailed it! That's how a real scientist thinks.

beliefs.title: Ideas to test
beliefs.body: Lots of people think these are true. Each one has an experiment that puts it to the test.

levels.title: Pick your level
levels.body: Turn the knob to your grade. The big tile shows your level. Its experiments sit on the shelf below.

footer.line: A science lab for curious students. Your progress stays on this device.

captions.landing: Two thuds at the same moment
